title: Who sent you over?
setting: A Saturday evening party at Kenta and Sora's flat. Yuki brought her coworker Mai, then spent the whole evening catching up with Kenta. Mai has been standing on her own when Sora comes over.

speakers.name: Mai
speakers.voice: female, late 20s, warm, a little shy

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: ano, sumimasen. yuki-san no tomodachi desu ka?
lines.ja: あの、すみません。ユキさんの友達ですか？
lines.kana: あの、すみません。ゆきさんのともだちですか？
lines.english: Um, excuse me. Are you a friend of Yuki's?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: a, hai. yuki-san to wa, shigoto de.
lines.ja: あ、はい。ユキさんとは、仕事で。
lines.kana: あ、はい。ゆきさんとは、しごとで。
lines.english: Oh, yes. We know each other from work.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: boku, sora desu. kenta to koko ni sunderu n desu. namae, oshiete moraemasu ka?
lines.ja: 僕、ソラです。ケンタとここに住んでるんです。名前、教えてもらえますか？
lines.kana: ぼく、そらです。けんたとここにすんでるんです。なまえ、おしえてもらえますか？
lines.english: I'm Sora. I live here with Kenta. Can I ask your name?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: kimura mai desu. a, koe kakete kurete, arigatou gozaimasu.
lines.ja: 木村マイです。あ、声かけてくれて、ありがとうございます。
lines.kana: きむらまいです。あ、こえかけてくれて、ありがとうございます。
lines.english: I'm Mai Kimura. Oh, and thanks for coming over to say hi.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: ie ie. yuki-san to kenta, zutto mukashi no hanashi shiteru n desu yo.
lines.ja: いえいえ。ユキさんとケンタ、ずっと昔の話してるんですよ。
lines.kana: いえいえ。ゆきさんとけんた、ずっとむかしのはなししてるんですよ。
lines.english: Not at all. Yuki and Kenta have been going on about the old days all evening.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: ano futari, gakkou de tomodachi ni natta n desu yo ne. ii naa.
lines.ja: あの二人、学校で友達になったんですよね。いいなあ。
lines.kana: あのふたり、がっこうでともだちになったんですよね。いいなあ。
lines.english: Those two became friends at school, right? Lucky them.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: ii desu yo ne. boku, koko ni sunde ninen, tomodachi, kenta shika dekitenai n desu yo.
lines.ja: いいですよね。僕、ここに住んで二年、友達、ケンタしかできてないんですよ。
lines.kana: いいですよね。ぼく、ここにすんでにねん、ともだち、けんたしかできてないんですよ。
lines.english: I know, right? I've lived here two years, and Kenta's the only friend I've made.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: watashi mo desu. shigoto ga isogashikute, deai ga nai n desu.
lines.ja: 私もです。仕事が忙しくて、出会いがないんです。
lines.kana: わたしもです。しごとがいそがしくて、であいがないんです。
lines.english: Same here. Work keeps me so busy, I never meet anyone.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: sore ni boku, jibun kara koe kakeru no, dame na n desu yo.
lines.ja: それに僕、自分から声かけるの、だめなんですよ。
lines.kana: それにぼく、じぶんからこえかけるの、だめなんですよ。
lines.english: Plus I'm hopeless at going up to people.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: e? demo, ima koe kakete kureta noni.
lines.ja: え？でも、今声かけてくれたのに。
lines.kana: え？でも、いまこえかけてくれたのに。
lines.english: Huh? But you just came over and talked to me.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: a, sore wa, kenta ga, yuki no tomodachi ni koe kakete tte.
lines.ja: あ、それは、ケンタが、ユキの友達に声かけてって。
lines.kana: あ、それは、けんたが、ゆきのともだちにこえかけてって。
lines.english: Oh, that. Kenta told me to go and talk to Yuki's friend.

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: e, watashi mo desu! yuki-san ga, sora-san no namae oshiete kurete, koe kakete mite tte.
lines.ja: え、私もです！ユキさんが、ソラさんの名前教えてくれて、声かけてみてって。
lines.kana: え、わたしもです！ゆきさんが、そらさんのなまえおしえてくれて、こえかけてみてって。
lines.english: What, me too! Yuki told me your name and said I should try going over to you.

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: ano futari! jaa, kimura-san, kyou wa deai, arimashita ne.
lines.ja: あの二人！じゃあ、木村さん、今日は出会い、ありましたね。
lines.kana: あのふたり！じゃあ、きむらさん、きょうはであい、ありましたね。
lines.english: Those two! Well, Kimura-san, looks like you did meet someone today.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: mai, gomen ne! a, sora-kun, mai to hanashita?
lines.ja: マイ、ごめんね！あ、ソラくん、マイと話した？
lines.kana: まい、ごめんね！あ、そらくん、まいとはなした？
lines.english: Mai, sorry! Oh, Sora, have you talked to Mai?

lines.speaker: sora
lines.romaji: hai. namae mo oshiete moraimashita yo.
lines.ja: はい。名前も教えてもらいましたよ。
lines.kana: はい。なまえもおしえてもらいましたよ。
lines.english: Yep. She's even told me her name.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, mou? jaa, futari, tomodachi ni natta no?
lines.ja: え、もう？じゃあ、二人、友達になったの？
lines.kana: え、もう？じゃあ、ふたり、ともだちになったの？
lines.english: What, already? So, are you two friends now?

lines.speaker: mai
lines.romaji: un, tomodachi dekita yo. yuki-san to kenta-san no okage de ne.
lines.ja: うん、友達できたよ。ユキさんとケンタさんのおかげでね。
lines.kana: うん、ともだちできたよ。ゆきさんとけんたさんのおかげでね。
lines.english: Yep, I've made a friend. All thanks to you and Kenta.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: desho? kyou wa ii deai ga aru kamo tte, itta jan.
lines.ja: でしょ？今日はいい出会いがあるかもって、言ったじゃん。
lines.kana: でしょ？きょうはいいであいがあるかもって、いったじゃん。
lines.english: See? I told you you might meet someone nice today.

choices.english: Sora comes over to talk to Mai; they find out Kenta and Yuki each told them to talk to the other, and they end up friends.
Mai goes over to Sora because Yuki told her to, and they find out they went to the same school.
Sora asks Mai her name, but she's upset when she finds out Kenta sent him over.

questions.explanation: Lines 1-4: Sora goes up to Mai and asks her name, and she thanks him for coming over (koe kakete kurete). Line 11: Kenta told him to (yuki no tomodachi ni koe kakete tte). Line 12: Yuki told Mai the same about Sora (koe kakete mite tte). Lines 16-17: Yuki asks if they're friends now, and Mai says she's made a friend (tomodachi dekita yo). B is wrong: Sora is the one who comes over (line 10: ima koe kakete kureta noni), and the school is where Yuki and Kenta became friends (line 6). C is wrong: Mai isn't upset. She says Yuki did the same thing to her (line 12: watashi mo desu!), and in line 17 she thanks them both, with a wink (okage de ne).

questions.english: You moved to a new town a month ago. Kenta asks, "koko ni kite, mou ikkagetsu da ne. tomodachi wa?" (It's been a month since you got here. Any friends?) You've made a couple. Tell him.
questions.ja: ここに来て、もう一か月だね。友達は？
questions.kana: ここにきて、もういっかげつだね。ともだちは？
questions.romaji: koko ni kite, mou ikkagetsu da ne. tomodachi wa?
questions.answer: Say friends have come along, with dekiru in the past: un, tomodachi dekita yo.

modelAnswers.ja: うん、もう友達できたよ。
modelAnswers.english: Yeah, I've already made some friends.

modelAnswers.ja: はい、友達ができました。

questions.explanation: Gaining friends takes tomodachi ga dekiru, and once it has happened it's past: dekita. That's Mai's line 17 (un, tomodachi dekita yo), and line 7 has the not-yet version (kenta shika dekitenai: Kenta's the only one I've made). English 'make' pulls toward tomodachi o tsukuru, but that's for setting out to make friends (tomodachi tsukuritai), not for saying you have some. tomodachi ni natta needs a particular person (X to tomodachi ni natta), and Kenta asked about friends in general. The second model is the polite version, for someone like Satou-san.

questions.english: Yuki comes back and finds Sora already knows Mai's name. What does she ask the two of them?
questions.ja: ユキさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: ゆきさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: yuki-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: So, did you two go and make friends?
So, have you two made any friends?
So, are you two friends now?
choices.romaji: jaa, futari, tomodachi ni natta no?

questions.explanation: Line 16: Yuki asks whether the two of them have become friends with each other, so it's tomodachi ni naru: futari, tomodachi ni natta no? It's the same shape as line 6, where Mai says Yuki and Kenta gakkou de tomodachi ni natta (became friends at school). B, tomodachi dekita, is gaining friends in general (have you made any friends?): it's how Mai answers in line 17 (tomodachi dekita yo: I've made a friend), not a question about two people and each other. A is English 'make friends' turned into tsukuru: natives say tomodachi tsukuritai for wanting to go out and find friends, not for two people who've just hit it off.

questions.english: You're at Yuki's party, and a woman you haven't met (it's Mai) comes over and says, "a, hajimemashite. yuki-san no tomodachi desu." (Oh, hi. I'm a friend of Yuki's.) She hasn't said her name. Ask her what it is.
questions.ja: あ、はじめまして。ユキさんの友達です。
questions.kana: あ、はじめまして。ゆきさんのともだちです。
questions.romaji: a, hajimemashite. yuki-san no tomodachi desu.
questions.answer: Ask her to tell you her name, with oshieru: namae, oshiete moraemasu ka?

modelAnswers.ja: はじめまして。名前、教えてもらえますか？
modelAnswers.english: Nice to meet you. Could I ask your name?

modelAnswers.ja: よろしく。名前教えてくれる？
modelAnswers.english: Nice to meet you. What's your name?

questions.explanation: Asking someone to tell you their name takes oshieru, the verb for passing on information: Sora does exactly this in line 3 (namae, oshiete moraemasu ka?). English 'tell me your name' points to iu, but namae o iu is saying a name out loud, not sharing it with someone. Line 12 has the same verb for passing a name along: yuki-san ga sora-san no namae oshiete kurete (Yuki told me your name). The second model is the casual version, once a party has loosened up.

questions.english: At a party, Mai keeps glancing over at Sora but doesn't move. She tells you, "sora-kun to hanashitai kedo, jibun kara wa chotto." (I'd like to talk to Sora, but going over myself is a bit...) Encourage her to go up to him.
questions.ja: ソラくんと話したいけど、自分からはちょっと。
questions.kana: そらくんとはなしたいけど、じぶんからはちょっと。
questions.romaji: sora-kun to hanashitai kedo, jibun kara wa chotto.
questions.answer: Tell her to go and speak to him, with koe o kakeru: koe kakete mite yo!

modelAnswers.romaji: daijoubu da yo. koe kakete mite yo!
modelAnswers.ja: 大丈夫だよ。声かけてみてよ！
modelAnswers.english: You'll be fine. Go and say hi!

modelAnswers.ja: 自分から声かけてみたら？
modelAnswers.english: Why don't you go up to him yourself?

questions.explanation: Going up to someone to start a conversation is koe o kakeru, literally putting your voice on them. Yuki says the same thing to Mai in line 12 (koe kakete mite: try going over to him), and Sora admits in line 9 that he's bad at it (jibun kara koe kakeru no, dame). English 'talk to' leads to hanasu, which is fine once you're talking: Mai already said she wants to hanasu with him. Getting the conversation started is koe kakeru.

questions.english: Mai tells Sora that work keeps her busy, and then says "deai ga nai n desu." What does she mean?
questions.ja: マイさんは、何がないんですか？
questions.kana: まいさんは、なにがないんですか？
questions.romaji: mai-san wa, nani ga nai n desu ka?

choices.english: She's so busy she never gets to see her friends.
She never gets the chance to meet anyone new.
She hasn't had a chance to talk to anyone at the party tonight.

questions.explanation: Line 8: a deai is an encounter with someone new, and deai ga nai is the stock complaint 'I never meet anyone'. Her life is work and home, with no new people in it, the same as Sora, whose only friend in two years is Kenta (line 7). A is English 'I never meet anyone' taken literally (dare ni mo awanai), which sounds like she never sees people at all, and she still sees Yuki. C is about tonight, but Mai is talking about life in general. Sora turns it around in line 13 (kyou wa deai, arimashita ne: well, you met someone today), and Yuki in line 18 (ii deai ga aru kamo: you might meet someone nice).

newWords.english: long ago, the old days (mukashi no hanashi = talk about old times)
two people; the two of them (ano futari = those two)
only (with a negative: kenta shika dekitenai = Kenta's the only one I've made)
thanks to (X no okage de = thanks to X)
